typography.rule: broad readable type; no compressed, stacked or stretched logo lettering

photography.default: natural-color approved hosts against monochrome charcoal
photography.identity: Vincent left; Mitchell right; preserve approved likeness, eye colors, proportions and direct eye-level gaze
photography.integration: native aspect ratio; complete heads and shoulders; background-matched edge fades, no banner zoom
photography.private_sources: original portraits, character sheets, recordings and face-containing working boards stay private

thumbnail.video_mark: white on dark, black on light
thumbnail.subject: source-grounded topic subjects and official topic logos in their original colors; no host faces
thumbnail.text: episode-specific; do not mandate text on every thumbnail

video_layout.background: same clip, centered on the faces, heavily blurred and darkened; no black bars

landscape_1080.use: 16:9 edited video, live scenes, slates and the Thumbnail Lab composite; 1.5x the 1280x720 template

web.show_og: host-led Think AI artwork, red bottom-right asterisk, no top-left wordmark
web.business_og: approved monochrome Your idea. We ship it. artwork
web.primary_contrast: black text on red show actions; charcoal text on white business actions

broadcast.signature: same six-arm geometry; state-specific contrast; verify actual camera/caption placement
broadcast.partner_strip: optional narrow strip, approved official logos and exact URLs

publication: Public kit includes guides and standalone marks. Publish only separately approved finished web/channel assets; source portraits and private working boards are excluded.
